mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipper ( id, shipper_code, shipper_type, name, email, phone, address, contract_number, discount_rate ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS UUID), #{shipperCode}, #{shipperType}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{contractNumber}, #{discountRate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, shipper_code, shipper_type, name, email, phone, address, contract_number, discount_rate FROM shipper WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS UUID)
SELECT id, shipper_code, shipper_type, name, email, phone, address, contract_number, discount_rate FROM shipper ORDER BY shipper_code
